title: Terms & Conditions
seoDescription: Read the terms for shared SEO tool access, plan limitations, payments, and support at SemrushGroupBuy.

sections.heading: Service and access
sections.text: SemrushGroupBuy provides information about shared SEO tool access. Access, included tools, session limits, and supported features may vary by plan. Check the details shown at checkout before purchasing.

sections.heading: Plans and billing
sections.text: The pricing, billing period, renewal conditions, and payment terms presented by the payment provider at checkout apply to your order. Review them before completing payment.

sections.heading: Fair use and third-party tools
sections.text: Shared accounts may be subject to usage limits and third-party terms. Do not share your member credentials or use access to disrupt other customers. Tool availability and features can change.

sections.heading: Support and policy questions
sections.text: For questions about access, billing, or account issues, contact our support team before purchasing. We do not promise uninterrupted access or features that are not listed in your plan.
